title: Model Guardrails & Sentinel: publishable performance profiles and pinning orchestration
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Customers onboarding models need a single, discoverable workflow in Console to publish validated performance profiles, create deterministic version pins, and understand pin impact before applying it to traffic. Current flows are fragmented across Model Details, Releases, and Insights pages which causes repeated support tickets and unsafe rollouts.

Goal: Design and ship a Console flow (Model Guardrails & Sentinel) that lets users: (1) mark a performance profile as 'publishable' after a validation checklist; (2) create a version pin from a published profile with configurable fallback rules; (3) preview expected latency/cost/quality delta across routes before applying; and (4) surface automated warnings when pins are potentially unsafe (e.g., large latency regressions or missing KV-cache support).

Scope: Console UI screens, minimal backend publish flag + API surface for pin creation, telemetry events for gating and rollout safety checks, and documentation + release notes. This ticket covers product design and acceptance, with ENG/Design tasks split to dependent tickets for implementation detail.
acceptance_criteria: Users can mark a performance profile as 'Publishable' only after required checks pass (evaluation badge, unit perf tests, and security sign-off)

A 'Create Pin' flow exists that is launched from a published profile and allows selecting: target routes (service/api), traffic split, fallback policy (model variant or region), and rollout cadence (instant/canary/gradual)
Preview modal shows estimated 95th-latency, median cost-per-token, and quality delta (based on eval set) with visual diff and a link to raw evaluation results
Console displays a sentinel banner if the selected pin would break SLOs or disables prefix-caching (with a link to remediation suggestions)
Backend API returns a pin object with publish_profile_id and rollout config; UI handles validation errors and displays clear remediation steps
Telemetry events emitted for: profile_publish, pin_attempt, pin_apply_success, pin_apply_failure, pin_preview_view (used by Product Analytics)
Documentation page and short how-to added to Console help center; release notes created
Security review is completed and signed off prior to GA (see linked PRD section)
Migration plan for existing manual pins: legacy pins must be importable to new pin objects via ENG migration script (ENG-4482)
tasks: Design detailed wireframes for Publishable Profile state and Create Pin flow (DES-8802)
Define backend publish flag and REST endpoints: POST /profiles/:id/publish, POST /pins, GET /pins/:id (ENG-4482)
Implement preview estimation service: uses perf-profile metrics + route tokenization to compute estimates (ENG-4510)
Add telemetry schema and events to tracking plan (Analytics)
Write Console copy, help center article, and release notes
Run internal dogfood rollout with 3 customer teams and collect feedback
notes: Design trade-offs: we prefer conservative defaults for rollout cadence (canary 10% over 1 hour) to reduce blast radius; product may expose advanced options behind 'Advanced' toggle.
We considered embedding a full evaluator runner in Console but deferred to a link to the evaluation service due to runtime/infra cost.
Edge-case: models without KV-cache should be marked and the preview should surface higher latency estimates; engineering to expose a 'kv_cache_support' flag on model metadata.
Related customer ask: ACME Payments requested preview by route — added 'target routes' in scope.
SLO thresholds sourced from infra SLO doc: https://redwood-inference.internal/docs/slo#latency-p95
